convention_rule: Four objects left to right map to P1-P4 (also matches listed order position 3 = P3); the single distinguished object marks the target.
basis: A: four poles, third from left uniquely glows green while others show red. B: four observatory domes, third from left uniquely open and lit with a beam. Both point to position 3 = P3, which is not the client-correct P4.
